scripts.studio: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.tsx
scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.tsx Reel out/reel.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=22 --x264-preset=slow --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=160k
scripts.publish: npm run render && npm run poster && swift scripts/faststart.swift out/reel.mp4 ../public/images/portfolio/showreel.mp4
